items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: And Eubie Blake was conducting, and Noble Sissle. And my mother made me get up and sing.

ctx.x: Was there an experience when you were young that you recall where you really got thrown in front of an audience where you had to really suck it up and — I think you mentioned something about your —

I was not ready. I was telling about how my mother was active in the community and at BAM, which is very famous now, Brooklyn Academy of Music, every year the Ladies’ Club, the “Amsterdam News” which is the black newspaper, Fresh Air Fund Benefit, they would cook, make magnificent food, go out and get cases of beer and booze for backstage musicians who donated the time. The whole Apollo would come over. I guess they must have heard about the good food and booze. And Eubie Blake was conducting, and Noble Sissle.…
And how old were you then?
